# World Music Scales Atlas

> An independent interactive educational atlas by Dr. Pouya Hosseini, with source-linked musical pitch and tuning models from around the world. Numerical representations are not full descriptions of musical traditions or definitive performance intonation.

## Reference resources

- [Scale reference library](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/reference.html): All public models and their source-linked individual HTML pages.
- [Public JSON catalog](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/catalog.json): App-facing tuning intervals, region identifiers and source metadata.
- [Interactive atlas](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/): Geographic exploration, transposition, playback and comparison.
- [Guide](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/guide.html): Explanation of the visualization and its limitations.
- [About](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/about.html): Authorship and related projects.
- [Sitemap](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/sitemap.xml): Discoverable HTML pages.
- [Terms of use](https://worldmusicscalesatlas.github.io/terms.html): Copyright, cultural rights and restrictions; this guide does not grant a license or authorize training.
